subject: Observability pricing — retention / tracing / advanced dashboards packaging questions
messages:
From: kimberly.park@redwood.ai
To: Ellie Harris <ellie.harris@novaanalytics.com>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Observability add-on pricing — initial options and a quick question

Hi Ellie —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our conversation I put together a short framing of the observability add-ons so we can align on scope before I draft a formal commercial. High-level options:

- Base observability (included): 30d trace + event retention, standard dashboards, token-level latency/cost telemetry
- Retention add-on: longer raw trace retention for audits (configurable 90d / 12mo / 24mo)
- Tracing premium: full-fidelity traces + export hooks, priced by GB-month of stored trace data
- Advanced dashboards: role-based dashboards, custom SRE widgets, scheduled reports (per-seat + per-org tier)

Attachment: observability_pricing_grid_v1.pdf (pricing grid + example packaging)

Quick question to help narrow options: for audits — what is your minimum required retention for traces and logs (e.g., 12 months)? Also, which teams need the advanced dashboard seats (SRE only, or SRE + Security)?

If you prefer, we can put together two condensed commercial options (compliance-first vs cost-optimized) and share Monday.

Cheers,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Ellie Harris <ellie.harris@novaanalytics.com>

Date: Thu, 19 Mar 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability add-on pricing — initial options and a quick question

Thanks Kim — helpful summary. A few data points from our side:

- Expected steady-state: ~500M tokens / month across ingestion pipelines (chat + batch indexing).
- Compliance requirement: internal auditors require 13 months of trace retention for any customer-facing incident investigations.
- SRE will need advanced dashboards (3 seats) and Security would like read-only access (5 seats) for quarterly reviews.
- Procurement looped in to confirm commercial constraints.

Procurement note: please include list pricing + committed-usage pricing and any standard enterprise discounts. We typically ask for a waiver of onboarding fees if we move quickly.

Ellie Harris
VP, Platform Engineering | Nova Analytics
ellie.harris@novaanalytics.com
From: marcus.lin@redwood.ai
To: kimberly.park@redwood.ai, lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 20 Mar 2026 08:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability add-on pricing — initial options and a quick question

Quick technical note to include in the proposal:

- 13 months retention is feasible but we should call out storage delta vs base 30d. Estimated incremental storage: ~1.8 TB/month of trace storage at current sampling levels (see storage_cost_estimate.xlsx)
- Tracing premium (full-fidelity) increases storage 3x vs sampled traces; consider sampling + export for compliance queries to reduce cost
- Dashboard seats: we recommend 3 admin seats + 5 read-only as requested; cost scales per-seat with volume discount thresholds at 5, 10, 20 seats
- Recommend offering a 12-month committed billing profile to get better unit pricing; include a mid-term audit clause for retention changes

Attachment: storage_cost_estimate.xlsx

--Marcus
Marcus Lin
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai

Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 23 Mar 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability add-on pricing — draft commercial options

Ellie —

Appreciate the context. Attached is a short commercial framing (we'll expand into a formal SOW once you pick an option). High-level options below:

Option A — Compliance-first
- 12-month retention add-on (13mo rolling) priced at $0.65 / GB-month
- Tracing premium (full-fidelity) $1.25 / GB-month
- Advanced dashboards: $350 / admin seat / month, $75 / read-only seat / month
- Annual commitment discount: 15% off list if you commit to 12 months at expected usage

Option B — Cost-optimized
- 12-month retention with sampling + export: $0.35 / GB-month (effective storage ~40% of full-fidelity)
- Tracing premium on-demand (burst) $0.90 / GB-month
- Dashboards: bundled at $250 / admin seat / month if >5 seats
- Annual commitment discount: 20% off list with a 12-month prepay and a 10% volume tier at 600M tokens/month

We can also offer a short pilot (30 days) with retention set to 90d to validate telemetry volumes before committing. If procurement wants an onboarding fee waiver, I can ask for a one-time waiver up to $10k for enterprise deals; will need quick verbal ok from management.

Linking the HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/DEAL-2026-004
Attachment: observability_pricing_grid_v1.pdf

If either option is a fit I can surface to Lauren for an approval on the discount. Next steps: pick Option A or B, confirm seat counts, and procurement's desired billing cadence.

Thanks,
Kim
